冬眠 Hibernation 在3日或更多时间内没有进食后，阿卡塔能分泌树脂，将它包裹在一个[[零晶]]（noqual）茧里。茧的硬度为9，HP 40，破损阈值 18。它对来自魔法的伤害具有抗力 5。只要茧保持完整，阿卡塔就无法被伤害，且它也不需要吃喝。在茧之中，阿卡塔获得生命感知 30尺。阿卡塔会一直处于冬眠状态，直到它暴露在极热环境下或察觉到活物，此时它可以在1d4分钟内破茧而出。
没有听觉 No Hearing 阿卡塔没有听觉器官。它对听觉效果免疫，需要它听的[[察觉]]检定自动大失败，并且在那些涉及声音但也依赖于其他感官的察觉检定（但不包括先攻骰）上受到-2减值。

recheckEvidence.content:
===活尸裔 BORAI===
活尸裔是生者与不死生物的奇异混合体，往往诞生于悲惨死亡或失败的复活尝试。灵体化血脉、顽执血脉与死灵化血脉各不相同，分别代表成为活尸裔的不同途径——或是复活尝试失败，或是自身不愿消亡，抑或是死灵法术实验的产物。

recheckEvidence.title: 活尸裔传承
recheckEvidence.content:
{{head|[[活尸裔传承]] {{!}} [[活尸裔专长]]}}
[[文件:Ancestry-borai-detail.webp|缩略图]]
{{CR|PC| / 多用传承 / 活尸裔 BORAI}}
{{intro|活尸裔既是生灵，也是死灵——他们的尸体经由自己的灵魂重新赋予生命，成为一种介于生死之间的存在。尽管属于实体不死生物，但活尸裔的身体是保护他们残破的不死灵魂的活体外壳，这使他们成为一种独特的存在。}}

　　<big>活</big>尸裔通常是通过失败的复活尝试（无论是魔法还是科技）或死灵实验而被意外创造。有些人则在濒死体验后，凭借顽强的意志与拒绝死亡的执念完成蜕变。当一个人成为活尸裔时，他们活着的肉体和不死的灵魂就无可避免地绑定在一起。活尸裔的身体从灵魂中汲取[[命能]]，防止外在躯壳的腐烂和衰退，而灵魂顽强地附着在他们的身体上，将其以诡异的方式永久封存于完美状态。即使活尸裔被杀死并复活或是转生，这种纽带也不会被切断，他们总是会以活尸裔的形态返回世间。

　　与许多种类的亡灵不同，活尸裔在死后仍然是同一个人——他们保留了自己的性格、记忆和情感，并且通常会努力维持他们在生前建立的情感联系和关系。然而，死亡仍在活尸裔身上留下了烙印，许多活物会本能地感觉到活尸裔身上有些不对劲，这使得活尸裔的人际关系变得紧张，社会状态也随之改变。这种缓慢破裂的友情和支持体系的恶化往往将活尸裔推出他们的舒适区，将他们从家园和过去的生活中驱离，走向未知的世界——这段经历使许多活尸裔变得愤世嫉俗、情感上有所防备，或渴望接受全新的体验。

　　如果你想扮演一个模糊生与死界限，在陌生的来世中挣扎着寻找归属，你应该扮演活尸裔。

{{扮演指导
|左=
* 决心取得成功，不接纳挫折或失败。
* 追求肯定生命的体验与关系，甚至可能鲁莽行事或损害自身利益。
* 对导致你死亡的原因感到恐惧，或避免回到你死亡之处，或莫名被吸引重返旧地。
|右=
* 将你与其他不死生物混淆，当你呼吸、进食或睡眠时感到惊讶。
* 觉得你的存在令人不安，即使他们无法确切说出原因。
* 向你寻求关于悲伤、失落、死亡和来世的建议。
}}

==外貌描述 Physical Description==
　　活尸裔在外形上与他们生前的样子相似，只是皮肤变得苍白且呈现出蜡般的质感，他们的血液被注入虚能，变成了一种粘稠的黑色脓液，透过肌肤清晰可见。由于他们的身体仍然是活着的，活尸裔必须呼吸、进食和睡眠，他们可以像其他生者一样被[[治疗]]、[[稳定伤势]]甚至复活。活尸裔的衰老速度极为缓慢，使他们能够多活几个世纪。在这段时间之后，活尸裔的身体会逐渐衰败，直到灵魂无法再维持它；活尸裔随后既会死亡（像活物一样），也会被摧毁（像[[不死生物]]一样）。学者们对这些灵魂是否会前往他们应有的来世，或是退化并立即重新投入[[创生熔炉]]的灵魂循环之中，意见不一。

==社会 Society==
　　被复活的活尸裔遍布在整个星系中，从[[协约世界]]到[[浩界]]，使他们成为一个多样化且人口分散的族群。大多数活尸裔"诞生"于[[伊奥克斯]]或其他死灵术、宗教复活仪式和追寻不朽的科学研究十分常见的地方。许多活尸裔在第二次生命中尝试像生前一样继续原有的生活，保持相同的习惯和人际关系——通常会通过化妆、[[幻术]]或[[殖装]]来隐藏他们的转变。尽管活尸裔可以在任何地方生活，但多数活尸裔会定居在不死生物更受接纳的地区，例如伊奥克斯。但由于活尸裔的生活仍需要与活物一样的舒适度，所以他们也很难融入不死生物的社会。

　　已经作为不死生物生活了十年以上的活尸裔，往往会将家庭视为友谊、忠诚和爱的体现，而非世系或血脉的联系。收养家庭与广泛交友十分常见，并且有些活尸裔会在雇佣兵或军事单位中找到伙伴，也有的会在同一个社会运动或宗教机构的成员中，或是在残酷的企业或财团的层级体系中寻得同路人。一些活尸裔拥抱他们令人不安的存在感和特质，成为恐怖的执法官或威风凛凛的保镖，而另一些活尸裔则通过担任治疗师、政治家或公职人员，努力克服与消除其不死本质带来的污名。

　　活尸裔没有普遍的命名惯例，大多数人会保留他们生前的名字。部分告别旧生活的活尸裔会自创新名，认为这些名字更能体现他们迈入人生下一阶段的身份认同。

　　'''范例名字：'''Agavana, Ajanu, Cailis, Enduri, Jiann, Kilarra, Orthei, Ruven, Taylehm, Thel-Sevai, Tis, Yevtori

==信仰 Beliefs==
　　活尸裔受到他们出生的文化和社会的影响，许多人继续敬拜他们在生前信奉的神祇，并坚守相同的哲学。随着时间的推移，大多数活尸裔倾向于崇拜被认为接纳不死生物的神祇，如[[厄加图娅]]、[[韦丹]]或[[宗-莎琳]]。追随现代潮流的活尸裔，往往崇拜[[兰巴图因]]，或发展出摒弃或归咎神祇的无神论。许多活尸裔在一种名为[[寂静之歌]]（Song of Silence）的哲学中找到了慰藉，它教导不死是生命的终极目标，凡人的生命不过是不死的预演。

*'''常见典范''' 拥抱活着，从过去中学习，拒绝将死亡视为终点
*'''常见禁忌''' 抛弃那些接受你真实模样的人，远离生命中的乐趣

==活尸裔（传承）BORAI (HERITAGE)==
　　你已经从死亡的边缘回归，成为活尸裔——既是活物又是不死生物。除了你族裔的特征外，你还额外获得[[活尸裔]]和[[不死特征]]。与其他不死生物不同，你不会获得[[虚能治疗]]。你依旧会被[[命能]]效果治愈，受到虚能伤害，如同你是活物一样。同样，你可以像活物一样被[[稳定伤势]]、治疗和复活，但你总是以你通常的不死状态（即活尸裔）复生。你获得[[昏暗视觉]]，或者如果你的族裔已经拥有昏暗视觉，则改为获得[[黑暗视觉]]。每当你获得一个族裔专长时，你可以从活尸裔专长和你的族裔专长中选择。

Trigger An ally you can observe triggers a trap.

sf2e-anachronism.class-features.json|/en.moduleOriginal:
Your exocortex manages a network of mines. You can deploy these mines with the Deploy Mine action and activate them with the Detonate Mine action or reaction. Your mines are shielded and can't detonate without your activation command. The DC to Disable your mines is your class DC. You can collect all deployed and undetonated mines as a single action, storing them alongside your other prepared mines in your custom rig.

During your daily preparations, you can create a number of mines equal to 4 + your Intelligence modifier, which is also the maximum number of mines you can carry. This number increases by two at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter. If you're below this limit, you can craft new mines using your custom rig. For every 10 minutes you spend in exploration mode, you create two mines; this doesn't prevent you from participating in other exploration activities. You can store all your mines in your custom rig without increasing its Bulk.

Though your mines are physical objects, they're destroyed if not used by the next time you make your daily preparations. They can't be duplicated or preserved in any way.

You can Modify one of your deployed mines at a range of 60 feet as if it were a grenade. Additionally, you gain the following new mods.

  • Smart Mine (mine exocortex): You program your mines with rudimentary virtual intelligence, allowing them to recognize your allies. Select one target within 60 feet. That target is excluded from the area of all mines you detonate. At 5th level, you can select up to three targets, and at 10th level, you can select up to six targets.

  • Targeting Mine (mine exocortex): Your mines' proximity sensors calculate precise explosions. Increase the mine's damage by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier.

sf2e-anachronism.class-features.json|/en.moduleOriginal:
Your paradox grants you magical power. You can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a witchwarper, when you cast spells, you might describe your revelations about other realities aloud, accompanied by elegant gestures while arcane equations or occult symbols blaze around you.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a witchwarper, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Charisma or Intelligence modifier, depending on which you chose for your key attribute.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witchwarper spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

Warp Spells

You can create powerful magical phenomena known as warp spells. Warp spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a warp spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to contemplate infinite worlds or conduct quantum magical research.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Warp spells have the anchoring trait, unlike other focus spells. This trait means you can only use warp spells while your quantum field is active, and you automatically Sustain your quantum field when you cast warp spells.

You learn warp spells based on your paradox.

sf2e-anachronism.class-features.json|/en.moduleOriginal:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

sf2e-anachronism.spells.json|/entries/Ho.moduleOriginal:
You reach into the target's mind, extract a specific memory you have some awareness of, and project it into a hologram. Alternatively, when casting this spell, you can choose to pull a random memory left to the GM's discretion. The holographic memory can be no longer than 5 minutes; if the extracted memory is longer than this, the hologram simply ends at that point. The hologram includes audio as well as visual components, but it doesn't contain haptic, olfactory, or other components. The hologram typically plays a memory that takes place in a single scene, though it can cut to multiple scenes if they're accurate to the memory and its length allows. The hologram plays the memory exactly as the target experienced it and from the target's perspective, so it often lacks context.

This spell can target any living, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or deceased sentient creature with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher. If the target is deceased, it can't have been dead for longer than 1 week, or this spell fails; once a corpse has been subjected to holographic memory by any caster, any subsequent castings of holographic memory fail.

If the target is unwilling to share this memory, it can attempt a Will save to resist this spell.

sf2e-anachronism.spells.json|/entries/Ho.moduleOriginal:
You reach into the target's mind, extract a specific memory you have some awareness of, and project it into a hologram. Alternatively, when casting this spell, you can choose to pull a random memory left to the GM's discretion. The holographic memory can be no longer than 5 minutes; if the extracted memory is longer than this, the hologram simply ends at that point. The hologram includes audio as well as visual components, but it doesn't contain haptic, olfactory, or other components. The hologram typically plays a memory that takes place in a single scene, though it can cut to multiple scenes if they're accurate to the memory and its length allows. The hologram plays the memory exactly as the target experienced it and from the target's perspective, so it often lacks context.

This spell can target any living, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or deceased sentient creature with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher. If the target is deceased, it can't have been dead for longer than 1 week, or this spell fails; once a corpse has been subjected to holographic memory by any caster, any subsequent castings of holographic memory fail.

If the target is unwilling to share this memory, it can attempt a Will save to resist this spell.

sf2e-anachronism.spells.json|/entries/Ho.moduleOriginal:
You let out a powerful ululation full of psychic resonance that compels others who hear it to join in. You deal 7d12 sonic damage and 1d8 persistent mental damage to other creatures who can hear within the area. Targets must attempt a Will save. The persistent mental damage a creature takes from this spell increases by 1d8 if at least one other creature is howling. A howling creature can't use auditory actions or cast spells except for those with the subtle trait for 1 round. Calculate the persistent damage after all creatures attempt their saves.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and no persistent mental damage.

Failure The target takes full damage, persistent mental damage, and is compelled to howl as long as it takes persistent mental damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double the initial and persistent damage.

While it has regeneration, the target can't die from taking damage, and its dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill it (this stops most creatures' dying condition at dying 3), though if its wounded value becomes 4 or higher, it stays @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until its wounds are treated. Once during the spell's duration, the creature can forgo healing Hit Points that round to regrow one damaged or ruined organ or reattach a severed body part by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.4cFhz9knnHUHj3wi]

sf2e-anachronism.spells.json|/entries/Ne.moduleOriginal:
You draw creatures into a vidgame, digitizing their bodies and minds, including equipment, to play in virtual reality. The genre of the game and effect of the spell depend on who you target when you cast it. Any creature targeted by this spell becomes immune to it for 24 hours, no matter what genre they experience.

  • If you cast the spell targeting yourself and any number of willing allies, the targets enter a relaxing slice-of-life social simulation game where they can perform up to 1 hour of activities for the duration of the spell, including Refocusing, Repairing items, or simply evading an enemy by hiding in this virtual extradimensional space.
  • If you cast this spell targeting yourself or one willing ally, and one enemy, the targets enter a PvP game and are instructed to fight, using their current initiative. For the duration of the spell, either creature can manipulate fate once on each of its turns. This allows it to either roll twice and take the higher result on an attack roll or skill check it attempts against its opponent (a fortune effect) or force the opponent to roll twice on a saving throw against one of its abilities and take the lower result (a misfortune effect). The GM might decide that other genres of games exist that add additional rules or subsystems to resolving the spell. The spell ends if either target becomes unable to act or if they both agree to cease hostilities. Any results of the game, such as damage or conditions, persist after the game is over. If a player dies in this game, they die in real life.
  • If you cast this spell targeting one enemy, the target enters a PvE or puzzle game that traps them until they can complete the game. Once each turn, the target can spend 1 action to attempt a Computers or Perception check against your spell DC to escape the game. Teleportation magic doesn't help the creature escape unless the magic can transport someone into or out of a virtual space. When the spell ends, either because the target escaped or the duration ran out, the target returns to the space it occupied when it was digitized, or to the nearest space if the original is now filled. The GM might decide that other genres of games allow for different skill checks but should only do so if the target has proficiency in the listed skill.

Critical Success The target completes the game and the spell ends.

Success The target makes progress toward completing the game. If the target already made progress, it completes the game and the spell ends.

Failure The target makes no progress toward completing the game.

Critical Failure The target loses the game and has to start over. It loses all progress it made.

note.original:
Picklecore, a blend of improvised jug band music, electronica, and power tools, is your jam. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:will|traits:auditory,linguistic] check against the Will DC of a single enemy or willing ally within 30 feet. This has all the usual traits and restrictions of a Performance check to sing. This can affect up to two targets within range if you have expert proficiency in Performance, four if you have master proficiency, and eight if you have legendary proficiency.

Critical Success If the target doesn't have the goblin trait, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn or the next time they're hit by a Strike, whichever comes first. If the target has the goblin trait, they instead gain a +5-foot status bonus to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.mKWPyxaEKvO5RrZx]

Success If the target doesn't have the goblin trait, they become off-guard against the next attack that you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.

Critical Failure You accidentally perform conventional music. As critical success, except goblins are affected as if they were non-goblins and vice versa.
note.final:
腌菜核（Picklecore）融合了即兴壶乐队音乐、电子乐与电动工具的声音，而你正好这一口。对30尺内一个敌人或自愿的盟友尝试进行@Check[performance|against:will|traits:auditory,linguistic]检定，对抗其意志DC。这具有以表演检定唱歌时通常拥有的所有特征与限制。如果你的表演熟练度为专家，此能力可以影响范围内至多两个目标；大师时至多四个，传奇时至多八个。

大成功如果目标不具有地精特征，便陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态，持续至你的下个回合开始，或下次被打击命中，以先发生者为准。如果目标具有地精特征，则改为使其各项速度获得+5尺状态加值，持续1轮。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.mKWPyxaEKvO5RrZx]{效果：腌菜核音乐（大成功）}

成功如果目标不具有地精特征，在你本回合结束前，面对你对其进行的下一次攻击时，它处于措手不及状态。

大失败你意外演奏出了寻常的音乐。如同大成功，但地精受到非地精的效果，非地精则受到地精的效果。

note.original: Thanks to years of practice, you know how to use every inch of the stage and give a fantastic performance even in tight quarters. While you can act, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking creatures of your level or lower.
note.final: 多年的练习让你懂得利用舞台的每一寸空间，即使在狭小区域也能献上精彩表演。只要你能够行动，你便不会对等级不高于你的以下生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}或夹击你的生物。

note.reason: 英文cannot/only if否定关系含糊；按段落上下文译为只有通过赎罪仪式悔过，才能与另一星球联结，保留规则与自动化。
note.original:
Your bond has grown into a kinship with all that lives on your planet. You're constantly under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants} while on your planet. You are considered a native of any planet in your bond. Creatures native to your planet feel an instinctual connection to you, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks when making a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} from them. Particularly helpful creatures may agree to minor tasks like delivering messages or spying on an area, but they won't do dangerous jobs or fight for you.

You vow to protect your bonded world. Gain the following edicts and anathemas.

Edicts defend your world from extraterrestrial threats, protect its natural resources from exploitation, form bonds with lifeforms on your planet

Anathemas disturb or harm your planet's ecosystem, plunder your planet's natural resources, exploit your planet's lifeforms

If your powers are lost due to anathema, you lose the effects of this feat and cannot bond with another planet only if you repent by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.
note.final:
你的纽带已经成长为与你建立纽带的行星上所有生物的亲缘关系。在你建立纽带的行星上，你持续处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C] 和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t] 的效果下。你视作任何处于你纽带中行星的原住民。你建立纽带的行星上的生物会与你产生本能的联系，当你向他们提出@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]时，在交涉检定上赋予+2加值。特别乐于助人的生物可能会同意完成一些小任务，如传递信息或监视某个区域，但它们不会为你做危险的工作或战斗。

你发誓要保护你建立纽带的世界。获得以下典范和禁忌。

敕令保护你的世界免受地外威胁；保护其自然资源免遭剥削；与你星球上的生命建立联结

禁忌扰乱或伤害你星球的生态系统；掠夺你星球的自然资源；剥削你星球上的生命

如果你因违反禁忌而失去力量，你失去本专长的效果；只有通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{赎罪}仪式悔过，才能与另一颗星球联结。

note.original:
You've spent a significant amount of time living in the desert and learned to control your thirst and move swiftly through shifting sands.

You can ignore difficult terrain caused by desert terrain (such as loose sand or gravel). In addition, you're less susceptible to dehydration. You don't take damage from dehydration until you've gone without water for double the usual duration of your Constitution modifier + 1.
note.final:
你在沙漠中生活了相当长的时间，学会了控制口渴，并在流沙间迅速移动。

你可以忽略沙漠地貌造成的困难地形，例如松散的沙地或砾石。此外，你也更不容易脱水。通常经过等于体质调整值加1的时间便会因缺水受伤，而你能坚持该通常时间的两倍，才开始受到脱水伤害。

note.original: Humans familiar with low-gravity environments are also better trained at dealing with the complete loss of gravity. At the end of each round in which you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3], attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a success, you ignore the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} conditions imposed by being in zero gravity for 1 round and can increase or decrease the number of squares you move by up to 10 feet (up to 20 feet on a critical success).

note.original:
Frequency once per day

Your body can repair damaged cells and even regrow missing limbs. You gain regeneration equal to half your level for 1 minute. During this time, you can't die from damage and your dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill you, though if your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value becomes 4 or higher, you stay @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until your wounds are treated. Each time you regain Hit Points from regeneration, you also regrow one damaged or ruined organ (if any), and you can reattach severed body parts by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.
note.final:
频率每天一次

你的身体能够修复受损细胞，甚至长出缺失的肢体。你获得等于你等级一半的再生，持续1分钟。在此期间，你不会因伤害死亡，濒死状态值也不会增加到足以使你死亡的数值；但如果@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{受伤}状态值达到4或更高，你便保持@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态，直到伤口得到治疗。每次因再生恢复生命值时，你还会长回一个受损或毁坏的器官，如果有的话；你也可以花费一个交互动作，将断肢按在断口处，重新接合。
note.status: 保留原参数并列明疑点

note.original:
Requirements Your target is larger than you.

You cling to a target with a sticky grasp. Attempt an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the target's Fortitude DC.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target Escapes. If the target moves, you move with them.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target Escapes. If the target moves, you move with them.

Failure You miss the target.

Critical Failure You miss the target and land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
note.final:
需求你的目标体型大于你。

你用黏着的抓握附着于一个目标。尝试一次@Check[athletics|against:fortitude]对抗目标的强韧DC。 大成功 目标陷入目盲直到你的下个回合结束，除非你移动或你的目标逃脱。如果目标移动，你随其一起移动。 成功 目标陷入目眩直到你的下个回合结束，除非你移动或你的目标逃脱。如果目标移动，你随其一起移动。 失败 你没有命中目标。 大失败 你没有命中目标并陷入倒地。

大成功目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}状态，持续至你的下个回合结束，除非你移动或目标脱逃。如果目标移动，你会随之移动。

成功目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态，持续至你的下个回合结束，除非你移动或目标脱逃。如果目标移动，你会随之移动。

失败你未命中目标。

大失败你未命中目标，并在落地时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}状态。

note.original: Your digestive enzymes can break down just about any organic material into food. You eject a spray of digestive enzymes in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20], dealing @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)+1)d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage plus 1d6 acid damage for every 2 levels beyond 9th (to a maximum of 11d6 at 19th level), with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The digestive slurry remains liquid for 1 hour. As long as at least one living creature in the cone failed its saving throw, the slurry contains nutrients that you can absorb to restore your body. If you spend 10 minutes absorbing the liquid slurry through your roots, you regain @Damage[(@actor.level*6)[healing]] Hit Points equal to 6 times your level.
note.final: ⟦X000⟧你的消化酶几乎能将任何有机物分解为食物。你喷出一片⟦X001⟧的消化酶，造成⟦X002⟧伤害，且9级之后每2级额外造成1d6酸蚀伤害（19级时至多11d6），进行一次⟦X003⟧豁免，对抗你的职业DC或法术DC中较高者。消化浆液在1小时内保持液态。只要锥形范围内至少一个活物豁免失败，浆液就含有可供你吸收、恢复肉体的营养。如果你花费10分钟用根系吸收浆液，你恢复⟦X004⟧生命值，等于自身等级的6倍。⟦X005⟧
